kpis.name: S&P 500
kpis.note: Broad equity risk-on/risk-off signal. High VIX or S&P drawdown signals demand risk for Southwire construction end markets.

kpis.name: Brent Crude
kpis.note: Energy costs affect Southwire manufacturing and logistics. Sustained Brent >$90 pressures freight and resin input costs.

kpis.name: Copper (LME)
kpis.note: Primary raw material. Copper content of wire drives COGS. Sustained elevation compresses margin unless hedged or repriced.

kpis.name: Aluminum (LME)
kpis.note: Key input for aluminum wire and cable. Price signals secondary cost pressure and hedge calendar triggers.

kpis.name: Freight (Drewry WCI)
kpis.note: Ocean freight index drives import costs on raw materials and packaging. WCI >$4K signals elevated supply chain risk.
kpis.change: Monitor Drewry WCI weekly for rate momentum

kpis.name: VIX
kpis.note: Equity market fear gauge. VIX >25 indicates risk-off environment; monitor customer demand signals and receivables.

kpis.name: Natural Gas
kpis.note: Energy input for manufacturing and logistics. Sustained elevation pressures margin. Drives residential heating demand indirectly.

kpis.name: Gold
kpis.note: Risk sentiment indicator. Gold >$3,000 with VIX elevation signals macro uncertainty that may dampen CapEx spending by customers.

wire.title: France's police fire tear gas and water cannons as school protests sweep the country
wire.summary: More than a quarter of a million people rallied nationwide to support school students demanding more education funding, according to government figures, with thousands of arrests.

wire.title: Here are the finalists for the 2026 National Book Awards
wire.summary: Three-time National Book Award finalist Edwidge Danticat and debut novelist Morgan Thomas are up for the fiction prize. Nonfiction books cover the prison system and music, and queer parenthood.

wire.title: What to know about nationwide protests in India over voter list changes
wire.summary: The campaign is led in part by India's "Cockroach" youth movement, which previously forced the education minister to resign.

wire.title: Vietnamese police arrest 12 suspected of prowling city streets at night, snatching cats for meat
wire.summary: State media cited investigators who said the network recruited people to ride motorcycles through neighborhoods at night, trapping up to 10 cats a night.

wire.title: Ex-spy chief is arrested in Germany on suspicion of trading state secrets and treason
wire.summary: A former head of Germany 's foreign intelligence service was arrested on suspicion that he had passed state secrets to a foreign intelligence service, the federal prosecutor's office said.

wire.title: Dems have edge in midterms, poll shows. And, Paramount-Warner Bros. merger to close
wire.summary: Polls are showing that Democrats have a clear advantage heading into the midterms, but that doesn't tell the whole story. And, today, a mega merger between Paramount and Warner Bros. is set to close.

wire.title: A history of presidents naming things after themselves (It's short. They rarely do)
wire.summary: While Trump pushes to get his name on the Kennedy Center and other public sites, history shows that sitting presidents have almost always avoided putting their brands on government assets.

wire.title: What voters in 6 key states could tell us about the 2026 midterms
wire.summary: Morning Edition is heading to Maine, Texas, North Carolina, Georgia, Ohio and Michigan to hear what voters say is shaping their choices ahead of the midterm elections.

wire.title: Francis Halzen wins Nobel Prize in physics for work on high-energy neutrinos from space
wire.summary: The 82-year-old scientist, originally from Belgium, is affiliated with the University of Wisconsin–Madison. His research into capturing neutrinos at the South Pole dates back to the 1980s.

wire.title: Disney, ABC battle Trump's FCC in court over free speech protections
wire.summary: President Trump has repeatedly called for Disney's ABC to fire late night comedian Jimmy Kimmel, for mocking him. Trump has also routinely denounced ABC's The View , accusing it of being unfair.

wire.title: Former German spy chief arrested for espionage and treason
wire.summary: August Hanning is accused of obtaining classified information for a foreign power.

wire.title: Ship sinks and crew missing after Black Sea drone attack
wire.summary: It is not clear who is behind the attacks which come as Russia intensifies strikes in the Black Sea as part of its war against Ukraine.

wire.title: White House defends Trump comment to let Iran 'take out' LA and San Diego
wire.summary: Gavin Newsom called the remarks "deranged", but the White House said Trump was warning of the risk of a nuclear Iran.

wire.title: Lawyer for one of Cornell 7 calls for special prosecutor to be removed over previous comments
wire.summary: New York Attorney General Letitia James is investigating the rape allegations, but the lawyer says comments she made on the case should disqualify her.

wire.title: 'Ghost particles' from space telescope wins physics Nobel
wire.summary: Belgian physicist Prof Francis Halzen has won for his pioneering work on an observatory that detects particles from space.

wire.title: Kenya confirms its first Ebola death as outbreak spreads
wire.summary: The patient had been living in DR Congo, where more than 4,000 people have died from the disease this year.
